solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Stumbled, beginning to go to get rent

indicators.note: the start of the word is to go, so its opening letter is dropped

parts.note: to stumble is to trip, so stumbled gives tripped

explanation.surface: Someone tripped while setting off to collect the rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like a payment, but here it is the past tense of rend: torn. 'beginning to go' drops the T from TRIPPED.
explanation.definitionFit: Rent is the old past participle of rend, meaning torn apart, a synonym.

clue.text: Tearing off without a word of thanks?

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone rushes away without saying thank you.
explanation.definitionFit: An ungrateful person gives no thanks, so the description fits the noun loosely.

clue.text: Girl coming out of shell?

definitions.meaning: the gem forms inside an oyster shell and is taken from it

explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name and also the gem formed inside an oyster.

clue.text: Devoted theologian drinking a brew of iced tea

indicators.note: drinking takes something inside

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian

indicators.note: a brew stirs things up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A dedicated churchman sips a cold tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theologian' is DD (Doctor of Divinity); 'drinking' signals the container and 'brew of' the anagram, with 'a' only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone devoted to a cause is committed to it, a synonym.

clue.text: At home, putting power into exercise is unprofessional

parts.note: at home is IN, a crossword staple

indicators.note: putting one thing into another signals a container here

parts.note: to exercise a right is to exert it
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Doing a workout at home with more power is somehow amateurish.
explanation.definitionFit: An inexpert job is an amateurish one, the opposite of skilled, so a synonym.

clue.text: Temporary but popular condition of contract covering island

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: covering means wrapping around

parts.note: a term is a condition in a contract

explanation.surface: A short-term contract clause is popular but covers an island.
explanation.definitionFit: An interim arrangement holds only until a permanent one, a synonym for provisional.

clue.text: Weariness meaning unit has just regulars?

indicators.note: taking only the regular letters means every second one

explanation.surface: A tired definition of a measuring unit uses only routine examples.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'meaning unit' are taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is listless boredom, a synonym for weariness.

clue.text: Capital invested by head of school

definitions.meaning: the sum of money originally put into an investment
the person in charge of a school or college

explanation.definitionFit: The main sum of a loan, and the title of a school or college head, both share the word.

clue.text: Course for army unit, mainly

indicators.note: mainly means most of it, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: a regiment is a unit of an army

explanation.surface: A training programme for an army unit, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' suggests a military course, but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A course of diet or exercise is a regime, a synonym for a set programme.

clue.text: Trying to impress King George with status

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
with can mean and, joining two things
standing is one's status or rank

explanation.surface: A monarch called George shows off his rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Showboating to win admiration or approval, especially by a politician, is the sense of the term.

clue.text: Conveyance for the upwardly mobile?

parts.note: upwardly mobile usually means socially ambitious, but here it means literally carried up a mountain

explanation.surface: A vehicle for social climbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cable-hung cabin hauls passengers up slopes, literally moving them upwards.

clue.text: Mine is worried about company pay

indicators.note: about puts the reworked letters around the company abbreviation
worried suggests the letters are shaken up into a new order

explanation.surface: A mine owner frets over the firm's wages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mine' looks like a pit, but it is fodder; 'is worried' shuffles it and 'about' wraps the result around the firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Pay is money earned, which is a synonym for earnings received.

clue.text: Animal rights covered by some measures

indicators.note: one thing covered by another sits inside it

parts.note: feet are measures of length
R is right, so two rights give RR

explanation.surface: Animal rights are protected by certain legal measures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Animal rights' reads as one phrase, but 'Animal' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A ferret is a small domesticated mustelid, an example of an animal.

clue.text: Suspend curate? It's ridiculous!

indicators.note: ridiculous suggests an absurd jumble of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone protests that suspending a curate is absurd.
explanation.walkthrough: To rusticate is a British university term for suspending a student, sending them to the country.
explanation.definitionFit: At Oxford or Cambridge a student suspended for a time is sent down, the crossword sense.

clue.text: Young female writer with time gets wasted

parts.note: a miss is a young unmarried woman
a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: A young woman novelist runs out of time and gets drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wasted' seems slang for drunk, but means squandered here.
explanation.definitionFit: Squandered youth or money is a synonym phrase for frittered away.

clue.text: Oxford's last worker?

parts.note: an Oxford is a style of shoe, and a last is a foot-shaped block it is made on

explanation.surface: The final employee in the university city.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobbler shapes footwear on a wooden form, so this craftsman works with that tool.

clue.text: Settles reserves to cover team

indicators.note: the reserves cover, that is surround, the team

parts.note: subs are substitutes, reserve players
a side is a team

explanation.surface: The bench players fill in for the first team and things calm down.
explanation.definitionFit: Floodwaters or ground that settle sink or calm down, a synonym.

clue.text: Improving and certain to include good growth

parts.note: up can mean improving, as in on the up

indicators.note: to include means to take in

parts.note: sure means certain

explanation.surface: Things look up and are sure to see good growth.
explanation.definitionFit: An upsurge is a sudden rise, a synonym for growth.

clue.text: Head of school to finish under peak salary

indicators.note: in a down clue, under means placed after
head of means the first letter

parts.note: a tip is a peak or top
end means finish

explanation.surface: A head teacher reaches the peak of their salary.
explanation.definitionFit: A stipend is a fixed regular payment, especially to clergy, a synonym.

clue.text: Worker from Mongolia strangely denied leave

indicators.note: strangely says the remaining letters are arranged oddly
denied means those letters are taken away

parts.note: to leave is to go

explanation.surface: A labourer from Mongolia is oddly refused time off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'denied' takes GO out of MONGOLIA, leaving MONLIA, which 'strangely' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone employed in the petroleum industry is one kind of worker.

clue.text: Broadcast operation after doctor gets supplies sent down

indicators.note: after places the operation piece after the doctor piece

parts.note: to broadcast is to air

explanation.surface: A broadcast surgery follows a medic who receives deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods parachuted from aircraft are delivered this way, so it matches provisions dropped.

clue.text: Metal one worn by mother after disheartening operations

indicators.note: after places the mother piece after the operations piece
disheartening removes the heart, the middle letter, of the word

parts.note: ops is short for operations

indicators.note: something worn by a person is held within them

parts.note: mum is mother
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A metal pendant is worn by a mother after depressing surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartening' removes the middle letter of the abbreviation, and 'worn by' puts the numeral one inside the parent.
explanation.definitionFit: Osmium is a dense bluish-white element, an example of a metal.

clue.text: Some lose by a mile after turning up, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means reading backwards
some means only part of the following words is used

explanation.surface: Someone may have lost by a mile.
explanation.definitionFit: Maybe means possibly, a synonym for perhaps.

clue.text: Young upstart initially invested in Marmite spread

indicators.note: invested in means put inside
spread hints that the letters are spread around, rearranged
initially takes the first letter of upstart

explanation.surface: A young upstart has money tied up in a yeast-extract spread.
explanation.walkthrough: Marmite is a British yeast-extract spread. 'initially' gives U, 'invested in' puts it among MARMITE's letters, and 'spread' rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: Immature describes someone not yet grown up, a synonym for young.

clue.text: Note about working with carbon drink

indicators.note: about in the sense of around means the note is placed round the working piece

parts.note: ti is a note of the sol-fa scale
on means working
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A note about working with carbonated drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonic water is a mixer, an example of a drink.

clue.text: New York carer needs to lose small table for working out

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters that follow
to lose means a letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A New York care worker needs to lose weight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New York' is not a place here: 'New' is the anagram signal. 'to lose' drops S from NEEDS, and the letters of YORK CARER NEED are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A booklet of precomputed figures that saves doing sums is this kind of reference table.

clue.text: Clergyman always trapped by split

indicators.note: trapped by means held inside

parts.note: to rend is to split
ever means always

explanation.surface: A clergyman is forever caught in a schism.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman is addressed with this title, so it stands for a minister.

clue.text: Mature, accepting European Community formula

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: ripe means mature

explanation.surface: An older Europe accepts a fixed formula.
explanation.definitionFit: A formula for success is a method, and a set of cooking instructions is the same idea.
